ezekiel.29.p1.b1.text: Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt and prophesy against him

ezekiel.29.p1.b2.text: Behold, I am against you, O Pharaoh king of Egypt, O great monster who lies among his rivers, who says, ‘The Nile is mine; I made it myself.’

ezekiel.29.p1.b3.text: I will put hooks in your jaws

ezekiel.29.p1.b4.text: I will leave you in the desert, you and all the fish of your streams.

ezekiel.29.p1.b5.text: when they leaned on you, you broke, and their backs were wrenched.

ezekiel.29.p1.b6.text: No foot of man or beast will pass through, and it will be uninhabited for forty years.

ezekiel.29.p2.b1.text: Egypt will be the lowliest of kingdoms and will never again exalt itself above the nations.

ezekiel.29.p2.b2.text: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon caused his army to labor strenuously against Tyre. Every head was made bald and every shoulder made raw.

ezekiel.29.p2.b3.text: I have given him the land of Egypt as the reward for his labor

ezekiel.29.p2.b4.text: In that day I will cause a horn to sprout for the house of Israel, and I will open your mouth to speak among them.
